title: Autophagolysosomal exocytosis inverts Src kinase onto the cell surface in cancer | Science
content: Overexpression of the proto-oncogene Src is common to a wide variety of cancers. In this work, we found that Src is noncanonically translocated and inverted onto the cell surface in cancer, both in vitro and in vivo. We identified autophagolysosomal ...
